copy.tagline: 设计符合业界规范的 REST API
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计或评审生产级 REST API
copy.tagline_en: Design production-grade REST APIs with industry patterns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing or reviewing production REST APIs

howto.what: Claude 会按照 REST API 设计规范，帮你设计资源命名、HTTP 方法、状态码、分页、过滤、错误响应、版本控制和速率限制等。
howto.when: 当你设计新的 API 端点、审查现有 API 契约，或需要添加分页、过滤、错误处理、版本控制等功能时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个用户管理的 REST API 端点。
say.note: Claude 会给出 URL 结构、方法、状态码和响应格式。

say.text: 这个 API 应该用哪种分页方式？

howto.what_en: Claude will help you design REST APIs following conventions for resource naming, HTTP methods, status codes, pagination, filtering, error responses, versioning, and rate limiting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when designing new API endpoints, reviewing existing API contracts, or adding pagination, filtering, error handling, or versioning.

say_en.text: Design a REST API endpoint for managing users.
say_en.note: Claude will provide URL structure, methods, status codes, and response format.

say_en.text: Which pagination method should I use for this API?
